schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Vendored, hot-path Go deps: patch/minor grouped so they land in one MR instead of a dozen.
Frontend (frontend/) grouped separately from Go so a Mantine/Vite bump doesn't block a Go patch and vice versa.
CI/runtime base images (golang, node, postgres, golangci-lint, playwright, docker, distroless, nginx).

apache/kafka is pinned in three independent places — docker-compose.yml, .gitlab-ci.yml (test:kafka's services container) and the Helm chart's values.yaml (helm-values manager, so it's outside the 'container images' group above) — kept deliberately in lockstep during the Bitnami migration. Group them so a bump lands as one MR instead of three drifting ones.

customManagers.description: GO_VERSION drives golang:${GO_VERSION}-bookworm images AND the go.dev download in test:pitr-drill — the gitlabci manager can't see through the variable interpolation.
NODE_VERSION drives node:${NODE_VERSION}-alpine images across the frontend/e2e jobs.
COSIGN_VERSION pins the cosign binary downloaded straight from GitHub releases for image/chart signing and release:verify.
